objective: Final deep readiness review before building an independent team boilerplate
decision: Ready for team boilerplate development on the supported stack; select a retrievable version for distribution.

scope.method: Reconciled prior whole-framework/security audits through current hashes; directly reviewed recent changes, runtime failure/ownership boundaries and consumer/package entry points. Not a claim that every unchanged line was reread.

changes.problem: Intl.PluralRules can round fractional scales greater than 20 to zero and select an incorrect form.
changes.resolution: Shared renderer uses the exported English fallback beyond its supported scale. Exact Go plural selection is unchanged. Generated-client/real-HTTP and exact-Go boundary/positive/negative regressions passed.
Public consumer proves explicitly selected pools survive built-in/custom/batched validation, real concurrent queries, cancellation/reuse and selected-pool failure without fallback.
Prepared recipes preserve serialization/rendering, bounded output and literal fallbacks.

changes.problem: Configured package omitted the localization fixture imported by its translation test.
changes.resolution: Include localization source and catalog assets with the configured profile; preserve ordinary profile isolation and verify source/assets in packaging regression.

source.fingerprint_format: SHA-256 of compact sorted JSON mapping relative .go/.ts/.mjs/.lua paths to SHA-256 file hashes, excluding caches/tool binaries/dependency trees as run.py specifies.

environment.cache: ordinary warm build cache; isolated package module cache; no new performance claim

verification.full_race_scope: Framework, plugin and complete consumer make race passed before the TypeScript plural and package corrections. Final client/i18n and release-tool races plus final make verify passed on the corrections; no Go production runtime changed in between.

failures_and_corrections.cause: Required Redis endpoint omitted from private runner environment.
failures_and_corrections.resolution: Restored established local endpoint without modifying product code; baseline and final gates passed.

failures_and_corrections.cause: Configured translation test could not import its omitted localization fixture.
failures_and_corrections.resolution: Fixed release source selection, passed release-tool races and final full gate, then prepared and verified a fresh candidate. Failed candidate retained unchanged.

failures_and_corrections.cause: New regression initially used TOML rather than the existing JSON locale asset format.
failures_and_corrections.resolution: Corrected fixture to the existing JSON convention; source file policy unchanged.

failures_and_corrections.cause: Process sampling was denied without the access used for earlier verification.
failures_and_corrections.resolution: Reran with the established access; docs-final-verified passed.

privacy.scope: Known private test URL/password absent from candidate archives and task evidence; prohibited private paths excluded.

source_and_tools.policy: Fail tool errors, malformed/incomplete results, affected function findings or any npm vulnerability. Preserve module/package-only findings for review.

security.review: No affected functions. Retained module-only GO-2026-5932 concerns unused OpenPGP; final packaged import graphs contain no OpenPGP packages. Existing gopls binary retains module-only GO-2026-6179/6180/5970 with no affected symbols. Zero npm vulnerabilities. These are known-database/symbol results, not universal security certification.

limits: PostgreSQL only; named pools supported, no distributed validation transaction.
Standalone Redis; supported macOS/Linux local persistence.
Linux amd64/arm64 compiled with CGO_ENABLED=0, not executed on Linux.
Historical AWS S3/R2 certification retained for unchanged adapters; no new live email/provider send.
Milestone 25 remains deferred; no new public module version was published.
version_control: No commit, push, merge, tag or publication.

documentation_verification.name: docs-final-verified
documentation_verification.result: Documentation links, blueprint numbering and fixture Go requirements valid.
